dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Have you finished your book yet?

dialogues.speaker: Wang Ping'an
dialogues.text: Not quite. Heh... well actually, to tell the truth, I'm still a long way off...

dialogues.speaker: Wang Ping'an
dialogues.text: I did collect quite a fair bit of material, but some of the stories don't have enough evidence to back them up.

dialogues.speaker: Wang Ping'an
dialogues.text: I've spent goodness-knows how much time just trying to confirm which sources are reliable.

dialogues.speaker: Wang Ping'an
dialogues.text: So as for my book... *sigh* Even I don't know how much longer it'll take at this point.
